verses.sloka: यस्मिन् तु दिवसे राजा चक्रे गो दानम् उत्तमम् ।तस्मिन् तु दिवसे शूरो युधाजित् समुपेयिवान् ॥१-७३-१॥
verses.transliteration: yasmin tu divase rājā cakre go dānam uttamam ।tasmin tu divase śūro yudhājit samupeyivān ॥1-73-1॥

translations.english: The day the king (Dasaratha) made a gift of the best (available) cows the heroic Yudhajit arrived.
translations.hindi: —:°:— अष्टषष्टितमः सगः जनकेन समादिष्टा दूतास्ते क्लान्तप्राहनाः । त्रिरात्रमुपिता मार्गे तेऽयोध्यां प्राविशन्‌ पुरीम्‌

verses.sloka: पुत्रः केकय राजस्य साक्षात् भरत मातुलः ।दृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा च कुशलम् राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७३-२॥
verses.transliteration: putraḥ kekaya rājasya sākṣāt bharata mātulaḥ ।dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalam rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-73-2॥

translations.english: Yudhajit, son of king Kekaya, Bharata's own maternal uncle met the king (Dasaratha) and enquiring about his wellbeing said:
translations.hindi: राजा जनक की आज्ञा पा, वे दूत शीघगामी रथों पर सवार हो और रास्ते में तीन रात्र व्यतीत कर, अयोध्या में पहुँचे | उस समय उनके रथ के घोड़े थक गये थे ॥?॥। राज्ञो भवनमासाद्य द्वारस्थानिदमत्रुवन्‌ | शीघ्रं निवेद्यतां राज्ञे दृतान्नो जनकस्य च

verses.sloka: केकय अधिपती राजा स्नेहात् कुशलम् अब्रवीत् ।येषाम् कुशलकामो असि तेषाम् संप्रति अनामयम् ॥१-७३-३॥
verses.transliteration: kekaya adhipatī rājā snehāt kuśalam abravīt ।yeṣām kuśalakāmo asi teṣām saṁprati anāmayam ॥1-73-3॥

translations.english: "My father, king of Kekaya affectionately enquires about your welfare. And they whose welfare you seek are hale and healthy.
translations.hindi: दूतों के ऐसा कहने पर उन द्रारपालों ने जा कर महाराज दशरथ से निवेदन किया । तब महाराज दशरथ की परवानगी से? राजा जनक के दूत राजभवन के भीतर गए

verses.sloka: स्वस्रीयम् मम राजेन्द्र द्रष्टु कामो महीपतिः ।तत् अर्थम् उपयातो अहम् अयोध्याम् रघुनंदन ॥१-७३-४॥
verses.transliteration: svasrīyam mama rājendra draṣṭu kāmo mahīpatiḥ ।tat artham upayāto aham ayodhyām raghunaṁdana ॥1-73-4॥

translations.english: The king of Kekaya, O Indra among kings, O Joy of the Raghus, desires to see my sisters's son and on that account I went to Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु अहम् अयोध्यायाम् विवाह अर्थम् तव आत्मजान् ।मिथिलाम् उपयातान् तु त्वया सह महीपते ॥१-७३-५॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu aham ayodhyāyām vivāha artham tava ātmajān ।mithilām upayātān tu tvayā saha mahīpate ॥1-73-5॥

translations.english: O King having heard in Ayodhya that you have arrived in Mithila along with your sons for their marriage I came here speedily with a desire to see my sister's son .

verses.sloka: त्वरया अभुपयातो अहम् द्रष्टु कामः स्वसुः सुतम् ।अथ राजा दशरथः प्रिय अतिथिम् उपस्थितम् ॥१-७३-६॥
verses.transliteration: tvarayā abhupayāto aham draṣṭu kāmaḥ svasuḥ sutam ।atha rājā daśarathaḥ priya atithim upasthitam ॥1-73-6॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, then accorded a warm welcome to the honoured guest.
translations.hindi: ओर विश्वामित्र जी की अनुमति से आपको यह सन्देशा -मैजा है कि, श्रीमान्‌ को तो यह मालूम ही है कि, मेरी पुत्री -वीयंशुल्का है ॥=॥ राजानश्च कृतामर्षा निर्वार्या विमुखीकृताः । सेयं मम सुता राजन्विश्वामित्रपुरःसरैः

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा परम सत्कारैः पूजार्हम् समपूजयत् ।ततः ताम् उषितो रात्रिम् सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः ॥१-७३-७॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā parama satkāraiḥ pūjārham samapūjayat ।tataḥ tām uṣito rātrim saha putraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ ॥1-73-7॥

translations.english: With the night spent with his virtuous sons, he who knew his duties got up at dawn and performed his daily devotionas and reached the sacrificial place following the rishis.

verses.sloka: प्रभाते पुनः उत्थाय कृत्वा कर्माणि तत्त्ववित् ।ऋषीन् तदा पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञ वाटम् उपागमत् ॥१-७३-८॥
verses.transliteration: prabhāte punaḥ utthāya kṛtvā karmāṇi tattvavit ।ṛṣīn tadā puraskṛtya yajña vāṭam upāgamat ॥1-73-8॥

translations.english: With the night spent with his virtuous sons, he who knew his duties got up at dawn and performed his daily devotionas and reached the sacrificial place following the rishis.
translations.hindi: वहाँ जा कर उन लोगों ने देवोपम वृद्ध महाराज दशरथ केः दर्शन किए और उनके सौजन्य को देख, निर्भय हो तथा हाथ जोड़ कर, बड़ी नम्रता से यह मधुर वचन कहे--महाराज !” ee +33>3-++3ल.ल०५०७+--+5 न २ कौशिकानुमतो वाक्यं भवन्तमिदमत्रवीत्‌ । पूर € [oN व प्रतिज्ञा विदिता वीर्यशुल्का ममात्मजा

verses.sloka: युक्ते मुहूर्ते विजये सर्व आभरण भूषितैः ।भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः कृत कौतुक मंगलः ॥१-७३-९॥
verses.transliteration: yukte muhūrte vijaye sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitaiḥ ।bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ kṛta kautuka maṁgalaḥ ॥1-73-9॥

translations.english: With the necessary auspicious rites preparatory to marriage performed at an auspicious moment, Vijaya, and keeping Vasishta and other maharshis in the forefront, Rama accompanied by his brothers adorned with ornaments of every kind came into his father's presence.

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठम् पुरतः कृत्वा महर्षीन् अपरान् अपि ।वशिष्टःओ भगवान् एत्य वैदेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭham purataḥ kṛtvā maharṣīn aparān api ।vaśiṣṭaḥo bhagavān etya vaideham idam abravīt ॥1-73-10॥

translations.english: With the necessary auspicious rites preparatory to marriage performed at an auspicious moment, Vijaya, and keeping Vasishta and other maharshis in the forefront, Rama accompanied by his brothers adorned with ornaments of every kind came into his father's presence.
translations.hindi: रि मेरै सौभाग्य से आ कर श्रीमान्‌ कुँवर ने जीत लिया है । “क्योंकि महात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने एक बड़ी सभा के बीच, उस “दिव्य धनुष को बीचोबीच से तोड़ा है । अतः में अपनी वीयेशुल्का सीता का विवाह श्रीराम जी के साथ करना चाहता हूँ

verses.sloka: राजा दशरथो राजन् कृत कौतुक मन्गलैः ।पुत्रैः नर वर श्रेष्ठ दातारम् अभिकांक्षते ॥१-७३-११॥
verses.transliteration: rājā daśaratho rājan kṛta kautuka mangalaiḥ ।putraiḥ nara vara śreṣṭha dātāram abhikāṁkṣate ॥1-73-11॥

translations.english: Adorable Vasishta approached king Janaka and said, "O King, of Videha king Dasaratha, the best of men with his sons having performed the auspicious rites preparatory to marriage is awaiting the bestower of the brides".

verses.sloka: दातृ प्रतिग्रहीतृभ्याम् सर्व अर्थाः संभवन्ति हि ।स्वधर्मम् प्रतिपद्यस्व कृत्वा वैवाह्यम् उत्तमम् ॥१-७३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: dātṛ pratigrahītṛbhyām sarva arthāḥ saṁbhavanti hi ।svadharmam pratipadyasva kṛtvā vaivāhyam uttamam ॥1-73-12॥

translations.english: The giver and the receiver, indeed, attain all ends. Fulfil your own duty by performing the auspicious marriage".

verses.sloka: इति उक्तः परम उदारो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ।प्रत्युवाच महातेजा वाक्यम् परम धर्मवित् ॥१-७३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktaḥ parama udāro vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।pratyuvāca mahātejā vākyam parama dharmavit ॥1-73-13॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the great self Vasishta, Janaka, the exceedingly generous, highly lustrous, eminent in ethics replied.
translations.hindi: शीघ्र यहाँ पधार कर अपने राजकुमारों को देखिए और है राजेन्द्र ! मेरी प्रोति को निबाहिए

verses.sloka: कः स्थितः प्रतिहारो मे कस्य आज्ञा संप्रतीक्ष्यते ।स्व गृहे को विचारो अस्ति यथा राज्यम् इदम् तव ॥१-७३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: kaḥ sthitaḥ pratihāro me kasya ājñā saṁpratīkṣyate ।sva gṛhe ko vicāro asti yathā rājyam idam tava ॥1-73-14॥

translations.english: "Did any guard prevent you? Whose command are you waiting for? Why do you hesitate to enter into your own house? This kingdom is like your kingdom".
translations.hindi: और यहाँ पधार कर दोनों राजकुमारों के विवाह की शोभा द्वेख प्रसन्न होइए । हे महाराज ! यह शुभ सन्देश महाराज जनक ने, महर्षि विश्वामित्र और अपने पुरोहित शतानन्द जी की अनुमति से आपकी सेवा में निवेदन करने को कहा है। इतना -कह और दशरथ के रोब में आ दूत चुप हो गए

verses.sloka: कृत कौतुक सर्वस्वा वेदि मूलम् उपागताः ।मम कन्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ दीप्ता वह्नेः इव अर्चिषः ॥१-७३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta kautuka sarvasvā vedi mūlam upāgatāḥ ।mama kanyā muniśreṣṭha dīptā vahneḥ iva arciṣaḥ ॥1-73-15॥

translations.english: O Best of ascetics my daughters have performed all the rites relating to marriage. They (now) stand at the foot of the altar shining like the bright flames of fire.

verses.sloka: सद्यो अहम् त्वत् प्रतीक्षो अस्मि वेद्याम् अस्याम् प्रतिषितः ।अविघ्नम् कुरुताम् राजा किम् अर्थम् हि विलम्ब्यते ॥१-७३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sadyo aham tvat pratīkṣo asmi vedyām asyām pratiṣitaḥ ।avighnam kurutām rājā kim artham hi vilambyate ॥1-73-16॥

translations.english: Ready at the altar, I have been awaiting you, O King Without hindrance proceed Why delay?".
translations.hindi: इन दूतों की बातों को सुन, महाराज दशरथ अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए और बसिष्ठ, वामदेव तथा अन्य मन्त्रियों से कहने लगे.

verses.sloka: तत् वाक्यम् जनकेन उक्तम् श्रुत्वा दशरथः तदा ।प्रवेशयामास सुतान् सर्वान् ऋषि गणान् अपि ॥१-७३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tat vākyam janakena uktam śrutvā daśarathaḥ tadā ।praveśayāmāsa sutān sarvān ṛṣi gaṇān api ॥1-73-17॥

translations.english: At the words of Janaka, Dasaratha brought his sons along with the hosts of ascetics and entered the marriage pavilion.
translations.hindi: विश्वामित्र से रक्षित, कौशल्या के आनन्द को बढ़ाने वाले लक्ष्मण सहित श्रीरामचन्द्र आजकल मिथिलापुरी में हैं

verses.sloka: ततो राजा विदेहानाम् वशिष्ठम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ।कारयस्व ऋषे सर्वान् ऋषिभिः सह धार्मिक ॥१-७३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tato rājā videhānām vaśiṣṭham idam abravīt ।kārayasva ṛṣe sarvān ṛṣibhiḥ saha dhārmika ॥1-73-18॥

translations.english: Thereafter the king of the Videhas to Vasishta, "O Adherent of righteousness, O Lord O Maharshi perform with the rishis the marriage ceremony of Rama who causes delight to the three worlds".
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का पराक्रम राजा जनक भली भाँति देख चुके हैं और अव वे अपनो कन्या का विवाह श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के. साथ करना चाहते हैं

verses.sloka: रामस्य लोक रामस्य क्रियाम् वैवाहिकीम् प्रभो ।तथा इति उक्त्वा तु जनकम् वशिष्टःओ भगवान् ऋषिः ॥१-७३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya loka rāmasya kriyām vaivāhikīm prabho ।tathā iti uktvā tu janakam vaśiṣṭaḥo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ ॥1-73-19॥

translations.english: Thereafter the king of the Videhas to Vasishta, "O Adherent of righteousness, O Lord O Maharshi perform with the rishis the marriage ceremony of Rama who causes delight to the three worlds".

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य शतानंदम् च धार्मिकम् ।प्रपा मध्ये तु विधिवत् वेदीम् कृत्वा महातपाः ॥१-७३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitram puraskṛtya śatānaṁdam ca dhārmikam ।prapā madhye tu vidhivat vedīm kṛtvā mahātapāḥ ॥1-73-20॥

translations.english: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-इस श्लोक में “यांद वो रोचते बृत्त” को देखने से यह अवगत होता है कि, रामायणकाल में एकाधिपत्य राज्यशासन-प्रणाली.` प्रचलित होने पर भी तत्कालीन राजा लोग अपने घरेलू कामों में भी अपने पाश्ववतियों की सम्मति लिए बिना कोई कार्य नहीं करते थे | ] मन्त्रिणो बाढमित्याहुः सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः । सुप्रीतश्चात्रबीद्राजा श्वो यात्रेति स मन्त्रिणः

verses.sloka: अलम् चकार ताम् वेदीम् गन्ध पुष्पैः समंततः ।सुवर्ण पालिकाभिः च चित्र कुम्भैः च स अंकुरैः ॥१-७३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: alam cakāra tām vedīm gandha puṣpaiḥ samaṁtataḥ ।suvarṇa pālikābhiḥ ca citra kumbhaiḥ ca sa aṁkuraiḥ ॥1-73-21॥

translations.english: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.

verses.sloka: अंकुर आढ्यैः शरावैः च धूप पात्रैः स धूपकैः ।शंख पात्रैः श्रुवैः स्रुग्भिः पात्रैः अर्घ्यादि पूजितैः ॥१-७३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: aṁkura āḍhyaiḥ śarāvaiḥ ca dhūpa pātraiḥ sa dhūpakaiḥ ।śaṁkha pātraiḥ śruvaiḥ srugbhiḥ pātraiḥ arghyādi pūjitaiḥ ॥1-73-22॥

translations.english: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.

verses.sloka: लाज पूर्णैः च पात्रीभिः रक्षितैः अपि संस्कृतैः ।दर्भैः समैः समास्तीर्य विधिवत् मंत्र पुरस्कृतम् ॥१-७३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: lāja pūrṇaiḥ ca pātrībhiḥ rakṣitaiḥ api saṁskṛtaiḥ ।darbhaiḥ samaiḥ samāstīrya vidhivat maṁtra puraskṛtam ॥1-73-23॥

translations.english: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.

verses.sloka: अग्निम् आधाय तम् वेद्याम् विधि मंत्र पूर्वकम् ।जुहाव अग्नौ महातेजा वशिष्ठो मुनिपुंगव ॥१-७३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: agnim ādhāya tam vedyām vidhi maṁtra pūrvakam ।juhāva agnau mahātejā vaśiṣṭho munipuṁgava ॥1-73-24॥

translations.english: Brilliant and worshipful rishi Vasishta chanted, mantras according to tradition, put the darbha grass of equal proportions around the altar, placed the fire on the altar, recited the mantras from the scriptures and offered oblations into the flame.

verses.sloka: ततः सीताम् समानीय सर्व आभरण भुषिताम् ।समक्षम् अग्नेः संस्थाप्य राघव अभिमुखे तदा ॥१-७३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītām samānīya sarva ābharaṇa bhuṣitām ।samakṣam agneḥ saṁsthāpya rāghava abhimukhe tadā ॥1-73-25॥

translations.english: Thereafter king Janaka brought Sita adorned with various ornaments and placed her in the presence of Agni in front of Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Kausalya. And said:

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् जनको राजा कौसल्य आनंद वर्धनम् ।इयम् सीता मम सुता सह धर्म चरी तव ॥१-७३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt janako rājā kausalya ānaṁda vardhanam ।iyam sītā mama sutā saha dharma carī tava ॥1-73-26॥

translations.english: Thereafter king Janaka brought Sita adorned with various ornaments and placed her in the presence of Agni in front of Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Kausalya. And said:

verses.sloka: प्रतीच्छ च एनाम् भद्रम् ते पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना ।पतिव्रता महभागा छाय इव अनुगता सदा ॥१-७३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: pratīccha ca enām bhadram te pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā ।pativratā mahabhāgā chāya iva anugatā sadā ॥1-73-27॥

translations.english: "This my daughter Sita will be your partner in performing her rightful duty. Accept her. Farewell. Take her hand into your own.

verses.sloka: इति उक्त्वा प्राक्षिपत् राजा मंत्र पूतम् जलम् तदा ।साधु साधु इति देवानाम् ऋषीणाम् वदताम् तदा ॥१-७३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktvā prākṣipat rājā maṁtra pūtam jalam tadā ।sādhu sādhu iti devānām ṛṣīṇām vadatām tadā ॥1-73-28॥

translations.english: By being a devoted wife this highly fortunate Sita would always follow you like a shadow". Thus spoken, he sprinkled the water sanctified with mantras (on them).

verses.sloka: देव दुंदुभि निर्घोषः पुष्प वर्षम् महान् अभूत् ।एवम् दत्त्वा सुताम् सीताम् मंत्र उदक पुरस्कृताम् ॥१-७३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: deva duṁdubhi nirghoṣaḥ puṣpa varṣam mahān abhūt ।evam dattvā sutām sītām maṁtra udaka puraskṛtām ॥1-73-29॥

translations.english: Then gods and sages exclaimed: 'well, well'. Celestial kettledrums were sounded and there was a steady rain of flowers.

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् जनको राजा हर्षेण अभिपरिप्लुत ।लक्ष्मण आगच्छ भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिलाम् उद्यताम् मया ॥१-७३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt janako rājā harṣeṇa abhiparipluta ।lakṣmaṇa āgaccha bhadram te ūrmilām udyatām mayā ॥1-73-30॥

translations.english: Then king Janaka sprinkled on Sita waters sanctified by mantras, and immersed in delight said:

verses.sloka: प्रतीच्छ पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ।तम् एवम् उक्त्वा जनको भरतम् च अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: pratīccha pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ।tam evam uktvā janako bharatam ca abhyabhāṣata ॥1-73-31॥

translations.english: "Lakshmana come and accept my daughter. Urmila ready to be bestowed upon you by me. Take her hand. Let there be no delay".

verses.sloka: गृहाण पाणिम् माण्डव्याः पाणिना रघुनंदन ।शत्रुघ्नम् च अपि धर्माअत्मा अब्रवीत् मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa pāṇim māṇḍavyāḥ pāṇinā raghunaṁdana ।śatrughnam ca api dharmāatmā abravīt mithileśvaraḥ ॥1-73-32॥

translations.english: Janaka, having spoken thus to Lakshmana addressed Bharata: "O Descendant of the Raghus hold Mandavi's hand in your own".

verses.sloka: श्रुतकीर्तेः महाबाहो पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना ।सर्वे भवन्तः सौम्याः च सर्वे सुचरित व्रताः ॥१-७३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: śrutakīrteḥ mahābāho pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā ।sarve bhavantaḥ saumyāḥ ca sarve sucarita vratāḥ ॥1-73-33॥

translations.english: The righteous king Janaka, said again: "O Mightyarmed Satrughna take the hands of Srutakirti".

verses.sloka: पत्नीभिः सन्तु काकुत्स्था मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ।जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पाणीन् पाणिभिः अस्पृशन् ॥१-७३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: patnībhiḥ santu kākutsthā mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ।janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā pāṇīn pāṇibhiḥ aspṛśan ॥1-73-34॥

translations.english: O Descendants of Kakustha (Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata and Satrughna) you all are gentle. You possess sound character. You are true to your vows. Live with your wives. Let there be no delay".

verses.sloka: चत्वारः ते चतसॄणाम् वसिष्ठस्य मते स्थिताः ।अग्निम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा वेदिम् राजानम् एव च ॥१-७३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: catvāraḥ te catasṝṇām vasiṣṭhasya mate sthitāḥ ।agnim pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā vedim rājānam eva ca ॥1-73-35॥

translations.english: At the words of Janaka the four princes took the hands of the four sisters with their own with the consent of Vasishta .

verses.sloka: ऋषीन् चैव महात्मानः सह भार्या रघु उद्वहाः ।यथा उक्तेन तथा चक्रुः विवाहम् विधि पूर्वकम् ॥१-७३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīn caiva mahātmānaḥ saha bhāryā raghu udvahāḥ ।yathā uktena tathā cakruḥ vivāham vidhi pūrvakam ॥1-73-36॥

translations.english: The great, noble princes of the race of Raghu, accompanied by their wives circumambulated the altar of the sacred fire. King Janaka and the sages in obedience to the directions of Vasishta and in accordance with the sastras conducted the matrimonial.

verses.sloka: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदन्तरिक्षात्सुभास्वरा ।दिव्यदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः।यद्वा -पुष्प वृष्टिः महति आसीत् अंतरिक्षात् सु भास्वरा ।दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषैः गीत वादित्र निःस्वनैः ॥१-७३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīdantarikṣātsubhāsvarā ।divyadundubhinirghoṣairgītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ।yadvā -puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahati āsīt aṁtarikṣāt su bhāsvarā ।divya dundubhi nirghoṣaiḥ gīta vāditra niḥsvanaiḥ ॥1-73-37॥

translations.english: While the descendants of Kakustha (Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata and Satrughna) held the elegant hands (of Sita, Urmila, Mandavi, and Srutakirti) there was a heavy rain of bright flowers from the sky.

verses.sloka: ननृतुः च अप्सरः संघा गन्धर्वाः च जगुः कलम् ।विवाहे रघु मुख्यानाम् तद् अद्भुतम् अदृश्यत ॥१-७३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: nanṛtuḥ ca apsaraḥ saṁghā gandharvāḥ ca jaguḥ kalam ।vivāhe raghu mukhyānām tad adbhutam adṛśyata ॥1-73-38॥

verses.sloka: ईदृशे वर्तमाने तु तूर्य उद्घुष्ट निनादिते ।त्रिः अग्निम् ते परिक्रम्य ऊहुः भार्या महौजसः ॥१-७३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśe vartamāne tu tūrya udghuṣṭa ninādite ।triḥ agnim te parikramya ūhuḥ bhāryā mahaujasaḥ ॥1-73-39॥

verses.sloka: अथ उपकार्याम् जग्मुः ते स दारा रघुनंदनाः ।राजा अपि अनुययौ पश्यन् स ऋषि संघः स बान्धवः ॥१-७३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: atha upakāryām jagmuḥ te sa dārā raghunaṁdanāḥ ।rājā api anuyayau paśyan sa ṛṣi saṁghaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ ॥1-73-40॥
